name: CIBC Dividend Visa Card

apr.notes: 21.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash (cash advances, balance transfers and CIBC Convenience Cheques) for non-Quebec residents, 21.99% for Quebec residents.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 0.5% cash back on all other purchases.

categories.label: Gas and EV charging, transit and rideshare, dining and recurring payments

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back of $10 or more can be redeemed at any time as a credit to the account.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none. Accelerated rates stop after $30,000 in total net annual purchases or $20,000 in the accelerated categories.
